data.summary_en: FC-SWE, a failure-conditioned RL framework, trains on failed patches and verification feedback as recovery-trajectory context, adapting GRPO with trajectory-local rewards and active-set advantage estimation; on 500 SWE-bench Verified tasks, Qwen3.5-4B with SWE-agent reaches 41.7% Resolved@1 and 52.8% Resolved@2, GRPO 38.9% and 48.5%.
